purpose: Teach: むちゃくちゃ/聴こえ/だまし/気が付か/呟き/めげ/つかまえ/おさえ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描き道具がむちゃくちゃに散らばってるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your art supplies are all over the place.
lines.style: Light, affectionate exasperation. Slight smile in the voice. Noticing the mess without real complaint — the tone of someone who's seen this before and finds it endearing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの声がはっきり聴こえるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can hear you really clearly.
lines.style: Bright, straightforward. Small voice full of attention. Speaking as though sharing something he's just realized. No self-consciousness, just pure observation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きでだましみたいに似せて描くのは凄いわよ
lines.en: Sho, the way you draw things — like you're tricking the eye into seeing them as real. That's amazing.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Genuinely impressed. Unhurried pace, like she's savoring what she's saying. The kind of praise that lands because it's specific and means something.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの優しさに気が付かない時があってごめんね
lines.en: Mei-sis, sometimes I don't notice how kind you are. I'm sorry.
lines.style: Soft, sincere. A little vulnerable but not fragile. Speaking carefully, as though the words matter. Quiet gratitude underneath the apology.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが「綺麗ね」って呟きで褒めて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, you know when Mei-sis whispers 'how pretty' — that's me praising you.
lines.style: Gentle, intimate. Speaking as though letting him in on a secret. Quiet contentment. The kind of tenderness that doesn't need volume.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きで失敗してもめげずに続けるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, even when my drawings mess up, I'm not going to give up.
lines.style: Steady resolve in a small voice. Not boastful — just matter-of-fact determination. A child finding his own strength and naming it aloud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと公園でトンボをつかまえに行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's go catch dragonflies together in the park.
lines.style: Bright invitation, genuinely excited. Warmth that reaches. Speaking like she's offering him something precious — her time, her presence. Openness in the pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、嬉しい気持ちをおさえる事ができないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can't hold back how happy I feel right now.
lines.style: Bursting with joy but still controlled — a 6-year-old trying to contain something too big. Breathless a little. Honest and unguarded. The whole self in those words.
